# Feature: Learning Modules (Technologies)

**Protection Layer:** Guest User [GU]

## Context & User Roles

- [GU] = Guest User
- [AU-L] = Learner (Authenticated)
- [AU-I] = Instructor (Authenticated)

## Directives

When working on the learning modules:

1. Technology Lists: Fetching and managing lists of technologies must be accessible to [GU].
2. Quizzes: Manage Questions, Options, Correct Answers, and User Scores.
3. Coding Questions: Structure Problem statements, initial code stubs, and test cases.
4. Notes: Handle Markdown/Rich text content rendering.
